expectations.notes: Minimal legal graph: one ConstInt node, header counts from live lengths, explicit zero state + journal length fields, flags 0, entry 0 (§2, §12).
String table: UTF-8 entry, raw NON-UTF8 bytes [0xFF,0xFE,0x41] (raw bytes round-trip byte-exact; get_string surfaces them lossy UTF-8, §4), and a zero-length entry (legal empty string).

Strategy producer convention (§13.3): contract WithinTolerance, WeightKind::Strategy, n=2 option weights 1/n PLUS trailing epsilon slot 1e-6 (len == operands + 1); pure NodeRef operands (§13.4 SameOutput-purity rule does not fire); exercises state_slot/annotation/activation round-trip.
choice producer convention (§13.3): AdaptiveChoice, contract None, WeightKind::Adaptive, exactly n weights = 1/n (len == operands).
Edge record (§8): ungated edge + gated edges (gate node ids in range; verifier edge/gate bounds pass).
State section (§9): u32 length + f64 LE values, explicit length field always written (conforming encoder rule).
Journal section (§10): WeightUpdate MUST be written as the exact byte 0x00, never an arbitrary out-of-range byte (§14 mutation row); exact bytes 0,1,5,10 pin the map.

conformance-v0.1-pins-CURRENT (§14 primitive-reads-past-EOF + §9/§10 count-at-EOF): real header + full node 0 (43B) + first 5 bytes of node 1 (id+op) + 25 literal zero bytes, which the decoder consumes as node 1's operand_count..has_state fields. The file then ENDS: weight_kind, has_annotation, contract and objective are READ PAST EOF and return 0 (Observational / None / None) — the zero-padding corner itself; the state and journal length fields are likewise ABSENT and default to 0 via the pos>=len branch. Guard/leniency interaction: a genuine cut at EOF here would first trip the MIN_NODE_BYTES guard (2 nodes x 34 = 68 bytes needed, only 48 remain), so zero padding is the only way a mid-node truncation reaches this corner. Re-encoding re-emits the record section identically but appends the two missing length fields (114 vs 102 bytes) -> NOT byte-equal. A conforming encoder MUST NOT produce this file.

conformance-v0.1-pins-CURRENT (§10/§14 journal-count-at-EOF): encoder output for a 1-entry journal, journal count field (4B) + record (17B) removed. Decoder yields an EMPTY journal silently (count missing at EOF => 0); the original entry vanishes without error. Re-encode appends count 0 + nothing else: 4 extra bytes -> NOT byte-equal.

conformance-v0.1-pins-CURRENT (§9/§14 state-length-at-EOF): file ends exactly where the node/edge sections end; missing state length => 0, missing journal count => 0. Re-encode appends the two length fields: 8 extra bytes -> NOT byte-equal.

expectations.decode: err:journal count 1 too large for input size: needs at least 17 bytes, have 8 remaining (header count out of bounds)
expectations.notes: SPEC ERRATUM pinned against the working tree (spec §10/§14 claim 'loop breaks silently; short journal accepted'): journal count 1 is present but the file ends after the record's run_number (8 of 17 bytes) — the tree REJECTS. MIN_JOURNAL_BYTES is exactly the record size, so check_count always rejects a mid-record truncation before graph.rs:542's silent break can fire; that lenient corner is UNREACHABLE. A short journal decodes only when the count field is entirely absent (see missing-journal-section).

conformance-v0.1-pins-CURRENT (§14 lenient enum coercion, spec §15.8): hand-assembled bytes — weight_kind 0x7F and 0x04 (WeightKind::Decision discriminant — NOT in the decode map, so even a legal encoder value for it round-trips to Observational), contract 0x09, objective 0x2A, journal mutation 0xEE — all DECODE (no error) to the documented defaults Observational/None/None/WeightUpdate. The out-of-range journal byte 0xEE is indistinguishable from the explicitly-written 0x00 in entry 1. Corrupt enum bytes silently change semantics; the verifier is blind to them (it checks semantics, not bytes). Re-encode normalizes all four fields to 0x00 -> NOT byte-equal; a future strictness change MUST flip these expectations as a versioned break.
